Fire at power station in Iraq's Basra kills at least 4, injures 35 At least 4 people were killed and 35 injured in a fire at a power station in southern Iraq on Saturday, with the toll expected to rise, security officials said. items.title: Cleveland Fed Model Sees a Slower Rise in November Consumer Prices - Mr. P Mindset
items.excerpt: The Cleveland Fed’s Friday inflation estimate points to a slower rise in consumer prices in November. Its model puts monthly inflation in the personal consumption expenditures price index at 0.17% in November, compared with a 0.31% estimate for October. Stripping out food and energy, the model shows much less change: 0.26% for November after 0.27% for October. Neither estimate is an official government reading. The model uses a small set of inputs, including daily oil prices, weekly retail gasoline prices and previous inflation data. Changes in oil and gasoline can move the headline estimate between release dates, while the core estimate typically reacts more slowly. The model puts November’s headline PCE inflation at 3.78% from a year earlier and its core measure at 3.32%. The monthly headline estimate can slow even as the annual core reading rises. Those comparisons use different periods, and one excludes food and energy.

items.title: Democrats won big in the midterms. So now what? By Reuters
items.excerpt: WASHINGTON, Nov 21 (Reuters) - Democrats basking in their November 3 election wins will soon unveil an ambitious legislative agenda for the first 100 days and beyond, in a test of progressives’ influence and Republicans’ willingness to cooperate, as they take control of the US Congress on January 3. That agenda is likely to be unveiled in early December once a Senate leadership race is settled. It will mark a thunderous reversal of the past two years, when President Donald Trump’s Republicans ruled the Senate and House of Representatives. With their narrow majorities, they rammed through major tax cuts skewed toward the rich and stood by as Trump grabbed their powers over tariffs and spending. Democrats’ new majorities in Congress are anything but narrow. With a 56-44 majority in the Senate they are four votes short of the 60 votes needed to advance most legislation. In the House, their 257-172 force could grow beyond an 85-vote margin once a handful of races are settled. "This is a realignment," said Democratic Senator Raphael Warnock of Georgia in a post-election interview with reporters. But in a warning to Democrats, veteran Republican Senator John Boozman of Arkansas said in an interview that despite his party’s losses across the United States, Trump remains "a powerful force" and "I don’t see any of his vetoes getting overridden" by Congress during his remaining two years in office. AGGRESSIVE AGENDA For months, Democrats have been plotting a House-Senate coordinated attack to undo Trump’s major accomplishments, according to lawmakers and aides. With the high cost of living the top concern voiced by voters, Democratic leaders are going after the low-hanging fruit that also would help unite their party’s progressives and moderates. Early votes are expected on legislation handcuffing Trump’s ability to wage war on Iran without Congress’ approval, which would help lower gasoline prices. Reversing Republicans’ deep cuts to Medicaid and SNAP food stamp programs would begin helping the poor meet healthcare and grocery costs. Meanwhile, progressives have urged raising the federal minimum wage, which is unchanged since 2009 at $7.25 per hour. Some are pushing for $20 to $25. And in response to voter disgust over Washington ethics breaches, one of the first bills Democrats are expected to present is one barring lawmakers from insider trading of stocks. Republicans face a bind: joining Democrats could anger Trump unless he backs measures, while stonewalling could anger voters. Eddie Redmayne returns as the Jackal, and the season premieres in March 2027. First-look images were released for Grantchester series 11, the eleventh and final series. It airs in January 2027 on ITV and ITVX. ## Casting and new films Auli’i Cravalho has joined Milo Manheim, Whitney Peak and Stephen Kalyn in a new Serendipity film from Amazon MGM Studios and Miramax. Ahan Shetty has joined Vikram Bhatt’s 1920: Cold Winter, the sixth film in the 1920 horror franchise. Filming runs from December 2026 to March 2027 in Ooty and Mumbai. Pooja Sharma and Ashok Darji are to star in Nepali film Seto Coat, officially announced on 20 November. Filming begins on 25 November 2026. Advance booking opened for Paral Ko Aago ahead of its nationwide release on Friday 20 November, with over 100 shows secured. Suhana Thapa, Saugat Malla and Prakash Saput star in the film, inspired by a story by Guru Prasad Mainali. ## Box office Drishyam 3 has closed its theatrical run with Rs 594.89 crore worldwide and Rs 381.32 crore net in India, on a reported Rs 110 crore budget, a return of 246.65 percent. Koimoi ranks it the highest-grossing threequel. The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping took an estimated $51 million on Friday, including $21 million from Thursday previews. Deadline projects a $110 million domestic opening weekend. Final numbers are due on Monday. ## Deaths E.J. Carroll, the veteran character and voice actor known for The Deuce, Law & Order and Boardwalk Empire, has died aged 66. He died suddenly on Thursday 19 November on his way to a voiceover recording session. His manager confirmed the death to TheWrap, and no cause of death has been determined.
